# Mediabunny 1.55.3 source availability

Anyfile bundles unmodified Mediabunny 1.55.3 source files into browser
JavaScript. Mediabunny remains licensed under MPL-2.0; the adjacent
`MPL-2.0.txt` contains the complete license text.

The exact upstream source is available in both locations below:

- npm package `mediabunny@1.55.3`, which includes its preferred TypeScript
  source under `src/`;
- Git tag `v1.55.3`, commit
  `16f8889e144f2bbeaa6a6788009abb4ecef19847`, at
  <https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/v1.55.3>.

Anyfile does not modify Mediabunny covered source files. Project-owned files
that call Mediabunny remain separate files and are licensed independently.
